cancer_status.progression_desc: Right M1 - post-treatment changes, stable. No new suspicious findings. Left M1 - normal.

specialty_specific_scores.score_desc: The breast parenchyma is scattered fibroglandular bilaterally. ACR B.
Right M1 - post-treatment changes, stable. No new suspicious findings.

non_cancer_findings.finding_desc: Post-surgical and post-RT changes in the right UOQ in keeping with previous WLE. Surgical clips in situ.
Seroma / fat necrosis in the right upper breast - stable cf. 2024.

report_summary: Bilateral surveillance mammogram 3 years after right breast cancer treatment (WLE, SLNB, adjuvant radiotherapy and ongoing letrozole). Right breast shows stable post-surgical and post-radiotherapy changes in the upper outer quadrant, with stable seroma/fat necrosis, surgical clips and stable skin thickening; no new mass, density, suspicious calcification or new architectural distortion. Left breast normal. No suspicious axillary nodes bilaterally. ACR density B. RCR right M1, left M1. Continue annual surveillance.
